blocks.text: Di pelajaran ini kamu belajar bicara tentang masa depan: «saya mau membersihkan kerak ketel», «wastafelnya mau meluap», «besok saya ketemu perawat». Caranya ada dua, dan keduanya sudah setengah kamu kenal.

examples.en: I am going to descale the kettle.
The sink is going to overflow.
I am meeting the carer tomorrow.

blocks.text: Kalau kamu sudah memutuskan melakukan sesuatu, bilang am / is / are going to + kata kerja seperti di kamus: I am going to repaint the wall — «saya mau mengecat ulang dinding». Penjepit, going, dan to wajib ada.

examples.en: I am going to descale the kettle.
She is going to repaint the wall.
We are going to alter the dress.
I am going to hang the bunting.

fixes.wrong: I going to descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am go to descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am going descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

blocks.text: Bentuk yang sama dipakai untuk menebak kalau tandanya sudah kelihatan: air sudah sampai bibir — The sink is going to overflow; menara sudah miring — The tower is going to topple.

examples.en: The sink is going to overflow.
The tower is going to topple.
The shelf is going to collapse.
The jumper is going to shrink.
The boards are going to rot.

fixes.right: The tower is going to topple.

fixes.wrong: The boards is going to rot.
fixes.right: The boards are going to rot.

drill.question: Air di wastafel sudah di bibir, keran masih terbuka. Kamu bilang apa?
drill.optionB: The sink is going to overflow.
drill.explain: Tandanya sudah kelihatan, sebentar lagi terjadi: is going to.

sections.title: Janji temu: I am meeting… tomorrow

blocks.text: Kalau kamu sudah janjian dengan seseorang dan ada waktunya — «besok jam enam» — pakai bentuk dari pelajaran 9: am / is / are + -ing dan waktu. I am meeting the carer tomorrow. Tanpa waktu, kalimatnya terdengar seperti «sekarang».

examples.en: I am meeting the carer tomorrow.
We are meeting the babysitter at six tomorrow.
examples.translation: Besok jam enam kami ketemu pengasuh anak.

examples.en: We are visiting a car boot sale on Sunday.
examples.translation: Hari Minggu kami ke pasar loak bagasi mobil.

examples.en: They are meeting at the book club tonight.
examples.translation: Malam ini mereka ketemu di klub buku.

fixes.wrong: I am meet the carer tomorrow.
fixes.right: I am meeting the carer tomorrow.

blocks.text: going to — kamu memutuskan sendiri: I am going to renew my pass. -ing dengan waktu — sudah janjian dengan orang lain, ada tanggalnya: We are paying for our membership on Friday. Keduanya tentang masa depan; bedanya, ada kesepakatan atau tidak.

examples.en: I am going to renew my pass.
I am bringing my appointment card tomorrow.
examples.translation: Besok saya bawa kartu janji temu.

examples.en: I am going to attend a christening.
examples.translation: Saya mau datang ke acara pembaptisan.

examples.en: We are attending a hen party on Saturday.
examples.translation: Hari Sabtu kami datang ke pesta lajang.

drill.why: Ada janji dan waktu: am / is / are + -ing.

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.wrong: I going to descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am go to descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

fixes.wrong: I am going descale the kettle.
fixes.right: I am going to descale the kettle.

blocks.text: «Mau» dalam bahasa Indonesia satu kata, dalam bahasa Inggris empat bagian: siapa + am / is / are + going + to. Jangan ada yang hilang.
Memutuskan sendiri — am / is / are going to + kata kerja. Kelihatan mau terjadi — juga going to. Sudah janjian, ada waktunya — am / is / are + -ing + kapan.

examples.en: We are going to apply an undercoat.
The scarf is going to unravel.
They are meeting the cleaner tomorrow morning.
examples.translation: Besok pagi mereka ketemu petugas kebersihan.
